Exercise 1: Initialise DVC in repository

Next we want to start using DVC with one of our projects. Let's follow DVC's documentation on getting started:

  1. Run dvc init

    Getting an ERROR: failed to initiate DVC - path is not tracked by any supported SCM tool (e.g. Git) error?

    Make sure you have initialised git in your directory. Run the following to start a git repo 

    git init

    If this does not work, try and run it with the --subdir argument if you are initialising this in a subdirectory of your project. 

     dvc init --subdir

  2. Check which files DVC added to the repo (what is each file used for?)

    Hint git status
    1. .dvc/.gitignore (dvc-specific things for git to ignore, like local config.local)
    2. .dvc/config (project-level dvc config, keeps tracks of various settings like remotes, local path to auth, etc)
    3. .dvcignore (file types for dvc to ignore if e.g. adding directories)

  • Git commit new files

    Hint git commit -m "YOUR COMMIT MSG"
